name: Mirroring for Azure SQL DB
description: Mirroring provides a seamless no-ETL experience to integrate your existing Azure SQL DB data with the rest of your data in Microsoft Fabric. You can continuously replicate your Azure SQL DB data directly into Fabric OneLake in near real-time, without any effect on the performance of your transactional workloads.[Learn more about Mirroring in Microsoft Fabric](/fabric/database/mirrored-database/overview)
